name: 3x3 RGB 216-bit saved-input to 72-bit grayscale (numeric-compatibility)

spec.architecture: 216 persistent input bits, stateless save-completion barrier and snapshots, nine stateless fixed-coefficient grayscale cores
spec.pixel_order: row-major, L1 is top-left, L9 is bottom-right
spec.output_encoding: nine unsigned 8-bit grayscale pixels in row-major order
spec.rounding: nearest integer; exact half rounds up
spec.color_processing: integer approximation on supplied encoded RGB bytes; no gamma decoding or color-space conversion
spec.input_protocol: Each frame supplies every X0..X215 exactly once, in one send or disjoint partial sends. Execution may occur between sends. Send no bit of the next frame until all 72 current output bits have published and FIFO is drained. No overlapping frames or repeated Xi within an incomplete frame.
spec.incomplete_frame: save received bits, retain unsent state bits, publish no new grayscale output until all 216 save completions arrive; reset may discard an incomplete frame
spec.output_validity: Each Yi publishes exactly once per complete frame, after all 216 state writes. Outputs publish separately; the complete 72-bit result is valid after all 72 fresh publications and FIFO drain. During a partial next frame, outputs retain the previous frame values.
spec.state_initialization: all 216 input-state q bits are 0; initialization emits no output
spec.state_update: J0K(Xi) overwrites the corresponding saved q with the new input bit; q persists until its next input event or reset

optimization.method: constant coefficients by shifted wiring, bit-column full-adder compression, shared Boolean expressions and constants, prune arithmetic nodes outside output ancestry

hash_contract: md5 = lowercase MD5 of UTF-8 recursively key-sorted JSON of {nodes, initial_q, q_y, spec}; array order retained
